domain_context: Brewery manufacturing operations, utilities/energy management, packaging execution (MES), quality and ISO50001 reporting

domains.description: Operational metering for electricity, water/RO, CO2 systems, biomethane and plant-wide daily/weekly/monthly utility KPIs.

concepts.context: Daily plant utility and submeter readings (electricity by area, fuel deliveries, compressors, tank levels).
attributes: Electricity kWh by area (Cooling, Air Comp, WWTP, CO2, Steam, WTP, Pumping, Misc, Compressors #1..#3)
CO2 Production/Compressor hrs/Tank to Factory/Cooling Compressor (Calculated)
joins: JOIN ElectricityConsumptionDaily e ON e.Date = UtilityConsumptionDailyFact.Date
JOIN UtilitiesMonthlyKPI m ON m.YM = UtilityConsumptionDailyFact.YID
concepts.business_rules: YID = Year*100 + Month. Treat area electricity columns as submeter attributes; optional unpivot for analytics.

concepts.context: Daily PowerManager readings with TX transformers and sub-metered consumers.
attributes: Submeters (Cooling Plant, WWTP, CO2 Plant, Steam, WTP, Pumps, etc.)
Packaging and building loads (BREW HOUSE, BMF_YEAST, KEGGING, KRONES, ZENON, etc.)
joins: JOIN ElectricityConsumptionWeekly w ON w.WID = ElectricityConsumptionDaily.WID
JOIN ElectricityConsumptionMonthly m ON m.YID = ElectricityConsumptionDaily.YID
LEFT JOIN DeviceMapping d ON d.ExcelCode = 'TX1' OR d.ExcelCode = 'TX2'
concepts.business_rules: Sum of TX1+TX2+TX3 approximates EAC; discrepancies captured as losses at month level.

concepts.context: Weekly aggregated electricity consumption including TX and (when available) submeter totals.
joins: JOIN ElectricityConsumptionDaily d ON d.WID = ElectricityConsumptionWeekly.WID
concepts.business_rules: WID = Year*100 + Week. Weekly EAC should reconcile to sum of daily EAC.

concepts.context: Monthly electricity with TX subtotals and transformer/EAC loss calculations.
joins: JOIN ElectricityConsumptionDaily d ON d.YID = ElectricityConsumptionMonthly.YID
concepts.business_rules: YID = Year*100 + Month. Loss % = losses_abs / TX or EAC basis. Keep negative losses for data-quality investigation.

concepts.sql_mapping:
SELECT 'D' as grain, * FROM [powermanager water - daily]
UNION ALL
SELECT 'W' as grain, Year, NULL as Month, Week, [From] as Date, DAW, YEAST, BMF, [Brew House RO], [CO2 Cooling RO], [Packaging RO], [Kegging RO], [Packaging CIP RO], NULL,NULL,NULL,NULL,NULL,NULL,NULL,NULL,NULL,NULL,NULL,NULL,NULL,NULL,NULL FROM [powermanager water - weekly]
UNION ALL
SELECT 'M' as grain, Year, Month, NULL as Week, NULL as Date, DAW, YEAST, BMF, [Brew House RO], [CO2 Cooling RO], [Packaging RO], [Kegging RO], [Packaging CIP RO], NULL,NULL,NULL,NULL,NULL,NULL,NULL,NULL,NULL,NULL,NULL,NULL,NULL FROM [powermanager water - monthly]
concepts.context: Daily/weekly/monthly reverse osmosis (RO) water consumption by area.
attributes: RO by area (Brew House, CO2 Cooling, Packaging, Kegging, Packaging CIP)
joins: JOIN WaterTreatmentPlantReading w ON CAST(w.[HM/NIA] AS date) = WaterROConsumption.Date
concepts.business_rules: Daily rows hold point-in-time; weekly/month aggregations should reconcile to sums of daily for the same period.

concepts.context: Daily CO2 tank levels, production and compressor/tank-to-factory meters.
joins: LEFT JOIN UtilitiesDailyMeters u ON CAST(u.Date as date) = CAST(CO2SystemDaily.Date as date)
concepts.business_rules: Year|Week is a presentation key; derive WID as CAST(REPLACE([Year|Week],'|','') AS int).

concepts.context: Daily multi-utility counters: CO2, boilers, softener, steam, air compressors, LFO, biomethane and WWTP/WTP related values.
attributes: Boiler burners, feed water, LFO flow and deliveries
joins: JOIN CO2SystemDaily c ON CAST(c.Date as date) = DATEADD(day, [Date]-2, '1899-12-30')
JOIN ElectricityConsumptionDaily e ON e.Year = UtilitiesDailyMeters.Year AND e.Month = UtilitiesDailyMeters.Month
concepts.business_rules: Convert Excel serial Date to date. Calculated metrics are derived deltas; prefer meters for audit.

concepts.context: Boiler/LFO/biomethane focused daily sheet including additional boiler efficiency and steam/bio gas KPIs.
attributes: Boiler burners, steam meters, diesel meters
Biomethane flow, storage pressure, tank level/delivery
joins: LEFT JOIN UtilitiesDailyMeters u ON u.Year = dr.Year AND u.Month = dr.Month
concepts.business_rules: Multiple overlapping fields with daily_db; when present, prioritize calibrated meters and tag provenance.

concepts.context: Monthly KPIs: WWTP effluent, compressor and cooling compressor hours.
joins: JOIN ElectricityConsumptionMonthly e ON e.YID = UtilitiesMonthlyKPI.YM
concepts.business_rules: YM = Year*100 + Month.

concepts.context: Daily biomethane meter and consumption values.
joins: LEFT JOIN UtilitiesDailyMeters u ON CAST(u.Month as int) = BiomethaneReading.Month AND CAST(u.Year as int) = BiomethaneReading.Year
concepts.business_rules: Zero readings imply either no operation or missing signal; validate against boiler operation.

concepts.sql_mapping:
SELECT 'WTP' as source, * FROM [wtp]
UNION ALL
SELECT 'WTP_DB' as source, * FROM [wtp_db]
concepts.context: RO/WTP process metrics and chemical dosing/pressures/flows/counters.
joins: LEFT JOIN WaterROConsumption r ON CAST(r.Date as date) = CAST([HM/NIA] as date)
concepts.business_rules: Use source to distinguish capture systems; recovery rate expected <= 80% (flag exceptions).

concepts.sql_mapping:
SELECT 'DAILY' as grain, * FROM [wm]
UNION ALL
SELECT 'MONTHLY_STOCK' as grain, * FROM [wm_monthly]
UNION ALL
SELECT 'MONTHLY_CONS' as grain, * FROM [wm_monthlycons]
concepts.context: Raw (Greek-labelled) water meters: daily counters, month-end counters and computed monthly consumptions.
joins: LEFT JOIN WaterTreatmentPlantReading w ON CAST(w.[HM/NIA] as date) = CAST(WaterMeters.DATE as date)
concepts.business_rules: Greek labels correspond to WTP/RO sub-processes; maintain a mapping reference for analytics.

concepts.sql_mapping: SELECT [Column1] AS ExcelCode, [Column2] AS PowerManagerName FROM [powermanager device mapping]
concepts.context: Reference mapping of Excel/short codes to PowerManager device descriptors.
joins: LEFT JOIN ElectricityConsumptionDaily d ON d.TX1 IS NOT NULL
concepts.business_rules: Use to standardize naming across reports and model dimensions.

domains.description: Consolidated energy and production KPIs for ISO50001 (EGF019), weather-degree days, working hours and visitor impacts.

concepts.context: Monthly energy balance with HDD/CDD, operations hours, production by format, electricity by area and compressors.
joins: LEFT JOIN Sustainability_ContextExtra x ON x.YID = ISO50001_MonthlyKPI.YID
LEFT JOIN ElectricityConsumptionMonthly e ON e.YID = ISO50001_MonthlyKPI.YID
concepts.business_rules: Values are month aggregates; ensure alignment of YID with utility domains. HDD/CDD used for normalized KPIs.

concepts.context: Contextual monthly environment/work-hour inputs for ISO50001 periods not present in core EGF019.
joins: JOIN ISO50001_MonthlyKPI m ON m.YID = Sustainability_ContextExtra.YID
concepts.business_rules: Use as override/backfill for EGF019 gaps; prefer EGF019 when both exist.

domains.description: Execution layer for daily production, SKU runs, line meters, packaging QC checkpoints, and inline consumptions.

concepts.context: Header entity for each production day, shift start and approvals.
joins: LEFT JOIN ProductionStartMeters s ON s.[Production Day ID] = ProductionDay.[Production ID]
LEFT JOIN SKUProductionEntry k ON k.[Production Day ID] = ProductionDay.[Production ID]
concepts.business_rules: One row per calendar date; supports multiple SKU runs under the same day.

concepts.context: Start-of-day line counters for utilities and meters.
joins: JOIN ProductionEndMeters e ON e.[Production Day ID] = ProductionStartMeters.[Production Day ID]
concepts.business_rules: Derived consumptions = End - Start (see PackManConsumptions for computed breakdown).

concepts.context: End-of-day line counters mirroring the start meters.
joins: JOIN ProductionStartMeters s ON s.[Production Day ID] = ProductionEndMeters.[Production Day ID]
concepts.business_rules: Capture end counters after last SKU. Differences feed daily consumptions.

concepts.context: Bright Beer Tank pull data per production day (HL and quality snapshot).
joins: LEFT JOIN SKUProductionEntry s ON CHARINDEX(CAST(BBTEntry.ID AS varchar(20)), s.[BBT Entries]) > 0
concepts.business_rules: SKU Production may reference multiple BBT entries (pipe-separated). Maintain a bridge for many-to-many.

concepts.context: Per-run SKU record with filler times, flowmeters and BBT linkages.
joins: JOIN ProductionDay d ON d.[Production ID] = SKUProductionEntry.[Production Day ID]
LEFT JOIN BBTEntry b ON CHARINDEX(CAST(b.ID AS varchar(20)), SKUProductionEntry.[BBT Entries]) > 0
concepts.business_rules: Where multiple BBTs feed a run, allocate HL by ratio of BBT HL or use flowmeter corrections.

concepts.context: Can line counters and final products for a given SKU run.
joins: JOIN SKUProductionEntry s ON s.ID = CanProduction.[Sku Entry ID]
concepts.business_rules: Use counters to compute can losses by stage (filler→Vipoll→Pasteur→warehouse).

concepts.context: Bottle line counters and final product packs.
joins: JOIN SKUProductionEntry s ON s.ID = BottleProduction.[Sku Entry ID]
concepts.business_rules: EBI and HEUFT counters used to isolate rejects and labeller performance.

concepts.sql_mapping:
SELECT 'CAN_QC' as qc_type,* FROM [packman - 08 - can qc filling p]
UNION ALL SELECT 'BOT_QC' as qc_type,* FROM [packman - 09 - bottle qc fillin]
UNION ALL SELECT 'CAN_DATE' as qc_type,* FROM [packman - 10 - can date coding ]
UNION ALL SELECT 'FCI_VIPOLL' as qc_type,* FROM [packman - 11 - fci after vipoll]
UNION ALL SELECT 'FCI_PASTEUR' as qc_type,* FROM [packman - 12 - fci after pasteu]
UNION ALL SELECT 'FINAL_PRODUCT' as qc_type,* FROM [packman - 13 - final product ch]
UNION ALL SELECT 'EBI_SAMPLE' as qc_type,* FROM [packman - 14 - ebi sample check]
UNION ALL SELECT 'EBI_REJECT' as qc_type,* FROM [packman - 15 - ebi rejection mo]
UNION ALL SELECT 'BURST_BTL' as qc_type,* FROM [packman - 16 - burst bottles]
UNION ALL SELECT 'FBI_FILLER' as qc_type,* FROM [packman - 17 - fbi bottle fille]
UNION ALL SELECT 'CAPPER_BREAK' as qc_type,* FROM [packman - 18 - capper broken bo]
UNION ALL SELECT 'CRIM_DIAM' as qc_type,* FROM [packman - 19 - crim diameter ch]
UNION ALL SELECT 'CHECKMAT' as qc_type,* FROM [packman - 20 - checkmat sample ]
UNION ALL SELECT 'LABEL_SAMPL' as qc_type,* FROM [packman - 21 - labeler sampling]
UNION ALL SELECT 'QA_TPO' as qc_type,* FROM [packman - 22 - qa- tpo entries]
concepts.context: Unified view of inline quality controls across can/bottle lines and checkpoints.
attributes: Key parameters (weights, volumes, O2/CO2, injector pressure/position, filling heights, label checks, lot numbers, TPO/PU, etc.)
joins: JOIN SKUProductionEntry s ON s.ID = PackagingQC_Checkpoints.[Sku Entry ID]
concepts.business_rules: Time series by SKU; use qc_type to route to domain dashboards; expected frequency per SOP.

concepts.context: Computed production vs idle utility consumptions per production day in Packaging.
joins: JOIN ProductionDay d ON d.[Production ID] = PackManConsumptions.[Production Day ID]
concepts.business_rules: Differences calculated from start/end counters; meters aligned with ProductionStart/End mappings.

concepts.sql_mapping:
SELECT 'BEER_LOSS' as loss_type, * FROM [packaging_ beer losses]
UNION ALL
SELECT 'BOTTLES' as loss_type, * FROM [packaging_ bottles losses]
UNION ALL
SELECT 'CANS' as loss_type, * FROM [packaging_ cans losses]
concepts.context: Loss accounting by SKU and container, including customs/flowmeters/BBT variance and unit-level rejects.
joins: LEFT JOIN SKUProductionEntry s ON s.[Product SKU] = PackagingLosses.SKU AND s.Date = PackagingLosses.[Ημερομηνία]
concepts.business_rules: Positive variance indicates losses; compute rolling KPIs excluding non-alcoholic if specified.

concepts.context: PU checks during pasteurization runs.
joins: JOIN ProductionDay d ON d.Date = [qa- pu entries].Date
concepts.business_rules: PU targets defined by brand/SKU SOP; trigger alert outside thresholds.

domains.description: MES-like tracking from URS for days, orders, time periods, incidents and SAP production order confirmations and components.

concepts.context: Daily shift envelope with start/end, missing/justified time and OPI.
joins: LEFT JOIN URS_Order o ON o.DAY_Date = URS_DayShift.DAY_Date
concepts.business_rules: One row per shift/day; OPI aligns to aggregated order OPI for the same date.

concepts.context: Order execution record with targets, actuals, timing and efficiency per SKU/format.
joins: JOIN URS_TimePeriod t ON t.ORD_Number = URS_Order.ORD_Number
LEFT JOIN URS_Incident i ON i.ORD_Number = URS_Order.ORD_Number
concepts.business_rules: ORD_Number is the primary execution key; production can span multiple time periods.

concepts.context: Sub-intervals for an order with produced packs, missing and justified time and efficiency.
joins: JOIN URS_Order o ON o.ORD_Number = URS_TimePeriod.ORD_Number
concepts.business_rules: Sequence (TP_Number suffix) defines chronological order; aggregate to order/shift metrics.

concepts.context: Downtimes and incidents (planned/unplanned) tied to orders and time periods.
joins: LEFT JOIN URS_TimePeriod t ON t.TP_Number = URS_Incident.TP_Number
concepts.business_rules: Use FourMs classification to drive RCA; pre-FPO downtimes tagged specifically.

concepts.context: SAP order header confirmations with basic dates, materials and confirmed quantities.
joins: LEFT JOIN SAP_OrderComponents c ON c.[Order] = SAP_OrderConfirmation.[Order]
concepts.business_rules: Order is the SAP manufacturing order key; PACK/WORT indicate process area.

concepts.context: Backflushed/consumed components (e.g., WORT) with required and withdrawn quantities.
joins: JOIN SAP_OrderConfirmation h ON h.[Order] = SAP_OrderComponents.[Order]
concepts.business_rules: Variance between requirement and withdrawn drives material usage variance KPIs.

concepts.sql_mapping:
SELECT 'PACKAGING' as area, * FROM [zsku_ppb_packaging]
UNION ALL
SELECT 'BREWING' as area, * FROM [zsku_ppb_brewing]
concepts.context: Z reports mapping FG orders to component actuals by area.
joins: LEFT JOIN SAP_OrderConfirmation h ON h.[Order] = SAP_ZSKU_MaterialUsage.[Order]
concepts.business_rules: Use area to segment BOM consumption. Component UoM varies (PC/KG/HL) — normalize in analytics.

concepts.context: Metadata for URS Access database objects present during ingestion.
concepts.business_rules: Reference only; not part of business metrics.

domains.description: Lab analyses for process and finished beer, including bright beer and cooled wort; raw materials QA.

concepts.context: Cooled wort lab measurements by batch and product.
joins: LEFT JOIN BBTEntry b ON b.[Batch #] = QA_CooledWort.batch
concepts.business_rules: Batch ties to brewhouse schedule; acceptable ranges per brand SOP.

concepts.context: Bright beer (BBT) quality metrics including AVOL, haze, RDF, CO2 and DO.
joins: LEFT JOIN BBTEntry b ON b.[BBT #] = QA_BrightBeer.BBT AND b.[Batch #] = QA_BrightBeer.batch
concepts.business_rules: Multiple BBT IDs possible per batch split; maintain many-to-many mapping.

concepts.context: Incoming malt batch QA (extract AS-IS, batch identifiers).
concepts.business_rules: Use to correlate brewhouse extract yields; maintain supplier specs externally.

domains.description: Product master for packaging (SKU library) and aggregated average production volumes across grains; ETL/metadata helpers.

concepts.context: Master data for packaged SKUs (brand, container, volume, pack/crate and labels).
joins: LEFT JOIN SKUProductionEntry s ON s.[Product SKU] = SKU_Library.SKU
LEFT JOIN PackagingLosses l ON l.SKU = SKU_Library.SKU
concepts.business_rules: Use as conformed dimension for packaging analytics.

concepts.sql_mapping:
SELECT 'ALL' as series, * FROM [avgprod - daily]
UNION ALL SELECT '2023' as series, [Material Number], Brand, [Unit Type], [Prod Vol ID], CONVERT(date, [Date], 103) as [Date], Value FROM [avgprod 2023 - daily]
UNION ALL SELECT '2024' as series, [Material Number], Brand, [Unit Type], [Prod Vol ID], CONVERT(date, [Date], 103) as [Date], Value FROM [avgprod 2024 - daily]
UNION ALL SELECT '2025' as series, [Material Number], Brand, [Unit Type], [Prod Vol ID], CONVERT(date, [Date], 103) as [Date], Value FROM [avgprod 2025 - daily]
concepts.context: Daily average production volumes by material across generic and year-specific series.
joins: LEFT JOIN SKU_Library k ON k.SKU = AvgProductionDaily.[Material Number]
concepts.business_rules: Normalize date formats (DD/MM/YYYY). Prefer specific year series when overlapping.

concepts.sql_mapping:
SELECT 'ALL' as series, * FROM [avgprod - weekly]
UNION ALL SELECT '2023' as series, * FROM [avgprod 2023 - weekly]
UNION ALL SELECT '2024' as series, * FROM [avgprod 2024 - weekly]
UNION ALL SELECT '2025' as series, * FROM [avgprod 2025 - weekly]
concepts.context: Weekly average production volumes by material (WID key).
joins: LEFT JOIN ElectricityConsumptionWeekly e ON e.WID = AvgProductionWeekly.WID
concepts.business_rules: Use WID to align with weekly energy KPIs.

concepts.sql_mapping:
SELECT 'ALL' as series, * FROM [avgprod - monthly]
UNION ALL SELECT '2023' as series, * FROM [avgprod 2023 - monthly]
UNION ALL SELECT '2024' as series, * FROM [avgprod 2024 - monthly]
UNION ALL SELECT '2025' as series, * FROM [avgprod 2025 - monthly]
concepts.context: Monthly average production volumes by material (YID key).
joins: LEFT JOIN ElectricityConsumptionMonthly e ON e.YID = AvgProductionMonthly.YID
concepts.business_rules: Use YID to align with monthly energy KPIs and ISO50001 reporting.

concepts.context: DataHub query/table load status overview for transparency and monitoring.
concepts.business_rules: Informational; not used for KPI calculations.

concepts.sql_mapping:
SELECT 'PPBPackFiles' as fn, * FROM [ppbpackfiles]
UNION ALL SELECT 'PackManGetSheetData' as fn, * FROM [packmangetsheetdata]
UNION ALL SELECT 'OnlyRefresh' as fn, * FROM [onlyrefresh]
concepts.context: Helper functions/placeholders discovered during ingestion.
concepts.business_rules: Non-business data; track as lineage aids.
